summary_en: Year-end dividend per share raised by 22 yen to 73 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, bringing annual dividend to 124 yen, following upward revision of full-year earnings forecast to 80 billion yen in ordinary profit and 55 billion yen in net income attributable to parent shareholders.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Performance Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Chugin Financial Group raised its year-end dividend per share by 22 yen to 73 yen for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, resulting in an annual dividend of 124 yen per share. This increase follows an upward revision of the full-year earnings forecast announced on October 29, 2026.

The revision was prompted by stronger-than-expected mid-term results driven by two factors: gains from securities portfolio replacement transactions executed in response to firm stock market conditions and the Bank of Japan's policy interest rate hike, and significantly higher fund management income including lending interest, securities interest, and dividend income resulting from rising domestic interest rates and the portfolio rebalancing activities.

The company targets a dividend payout ratio of approximately 40 percent while pursuing dividend growth through profit expansion and maintaining flexible share buyback programs through capital management. The previous year-end dividend for the fiscal year ending March 2026 was 53 yen per share.
